capabilities: schedule note reviews with SM-2 intervals
rate notes during review sessions with keyboard keys
generate AI quiz questions from note content via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
show due and new note counts in the status bar and statistics
import and prune review records, including legacy frontmatter data
disambiguation: Not a search or note-recall tool; it schedules reviews of existing notes and quizzes you on them.
extras: In beta and not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop-only. API keys are stored in plaintext in data.json, and the README warns about sync conflicts for that file and recommends vault backups.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review notes on a spaced repetition schedule or quiz yourself on their content.
summary: Spaced repetition plugin that schedules note reviews with SM-2 and optionally generates AI quizzes from note content.
